source_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-06: the previous file carried misfiled lines (total assets 316,016 and 374,591 were property and equipment, total liabilities repeated the non-current borrowings and the total liabilities row, and total equity was computed negative). Replaced with the audited statement of financial position, page 12 of the financial statements (page 47 of the report), N'000, 2024 and 2023 columns. Non-current assets plus current assets equals total assets exactly on 2024; on 2023 the printed non-current liabilities 2,797,675 plus current liabilities 10,743,985 exceed the printed total liabilities 13,541,659 by 1 (one thousand naira), a rounding in the source, and the filed figures are kept as printed. The three older columns (FY2022, FY2021, FY2020) held the same misfiled lines and were dropped rather than carried, because no audited group figure was available to replace them. Cash and cash equivalents is not stated as a single line in this statement (cash and balances with the Central Bank of Nigeria and due from banks are shown separately), so no cash row is written.
